participants.title: Vice President
participants.description:
Vision Centric, Inc. is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) headquartered in Madison, Alabama, established in 2004 with a mission centered on delivering total customer satisfaction through high-quality professional, technical, engineering, and administrative support services. The company specializes in acquisition and contracting support, executive and administrative services, systems engineering and technical assistance (SETA), logistics, program management, cybersecurity support, and operational support services for federal civilian and Department of Defense customers.

VCI supports a broad range of federal agencies by providing mission-critical solutions that improve operational efficiency, strengthen acquisition and program execution, and enable agencies to meet strategic and tactical objectives. Core capabilities include cradle-to-grave acquisition support, contract administration, engineering and systems integration, logistics and sustainment support, executive correspondence management, records management, financial and program analysis, IT support, and workforce augmentation. The company also delivers advanced engineering and technical services supporting Army hypersonic weapon systems, directed energy initiatives, and rapid prototyping efforts through programs such as the U.S. Army Rapid Capabilities and Critical Technologies Office (RCCTO).

VCI serves a diverse portfolio of federal customers across the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), Department of Defense (DoD), Department of Justice (DOJ), Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), and Department of Agriculture (USDA). Key supported agencies and organizations include the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), U.S. Secret Service (USSS), Federal Protective Service (FPS), U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS), National Institutes of Health (NIH), Air Force District of Washington (AFDW), U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), and the Army RCCTO.

VCI’s approach emphasizes recruiting and retaining highly qualified personnel, implementing rigorous quality assurance processes, and maintaining strong customer relationships that consistently result in exceptional performance ratings and customer commendations. The company has received recognition for improving operational processes, implementing innovative tracking systems, accelerating contract closeouts, supporting major agency transitions, and contributing to nationally significant initiatives, including CISA’s award-winning election security efforts.

participants.company_name: CapitolHill Consortium for Counseling & Consultation, LLC
participants.description:
Mission Statement: We improve our community by working together as a team to provide high quality, accessible, and culturally responsive mental health services, training, and consultation.

Located in Washington DC, Arlington VA, and Upper Marlboro MD, we are a multicultural and multidisciplinary large group private practice that provides psychotherapy and psychological testing to persons across the lifespan in modalities including individual, group, couples, and family therapy and testing including neuropsychological, cognitive, personality, and psycho-educational assessments.

On our own, and in collaboration with local mental health practices, we have expanded our capacity to win local contracts for direct care, training, and consultation. We establish referral connections with primary care practices, substance abuse clinics, schools, and hospitals for purposes of increasing access to mental health care for their patients.

We have partnered with a primary care physician, university research professor, and Ai technology specialist to create a patent pending product to enhance healthcare delivery with wide application. We are in the beta stage of development and talking to potential funders.

We are in process of planning integrated care with a group physicians to expand services on a national level.
